about: The mashup's systems, each with the code that runs it. game: where it runs (vs = the MelonLoader mod in VS, rounds = the engine in the hidden ROUNDS).

rows.does: the mod's start, frame loop and on-screen drawing
a MelonLoader plugin that points Il2CppInterop's GetDefaultFieldValue hook at the right function on VS's Unity 6 build (without it VS crashes 2 s after start with any MelonLoader mod)

start the player's own ROUNDS hidden with the engine (BepInEx as installed in UserData/VampireRounds/rounds, its log and cache beside it), keep its window out of sight, restart it if it stops, close only it when VS closes
VS's heartbeat and the engine's liveness on the shared memory
the adventure, its stage, Orange and Blue, their texts and pictures in VS's data and menus
a Vampire Rounds run: seats for Orange and Blue, camera, positions, input, health mirrored from ROUNDS, death and revive
VS's live enemies into the target table; ROUNDS's hits and effects back onto them
ROUNDS's picture over VS's stage (Orange, Blue, bullets, effects), the card bar and the pick screen
level-ups and chests become ROUNDS card picks while VS is paused
aim (auto or mouse), fire, block and pick input per seat
plain on-screen notes when ROUNDS is missing, the wrong version, already open or still starting
Melty's test run: plays the adventure by itself and marks each check
ROUNDS's sandbox with Orange and Blue held where VS puts them, VS's enemies as targets, the screen edges as walls
ROUNDS's picture of the run (and its pick screen) into the shared frame buffers
Orange's and Blue's pictures for VS's menus
the BepInEx plugin: waits for ROUNDS's cards, keeps the hidden window away, ends with VS
